result:
I could not confirm which change closed TRUNK-6643. Nothing in openmrs-core mentions "6643", and I have no commit-history tool here, so I can't name the commit or PR. What the code shows is that the wizard's create-user path now treats `mariadb` the same as `mysql`, which is the shape the fix would take.

**Where the fix lives (openmrs-core)**

- The create-user block in `InitializationFilter` now branches on `isCurrentDatabase(DATABASE_MYSQL) || isCurrentDatabase(DATABASE_MARIADB)` for the drop, create and grant statements. The MySQL-only branch that the ticket describes is gone. `create user '?'@host identified by '?'` is at `web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:1501-1502`, and the GRANT at `:1518-1519`. The drop is at `:1492-1493`.
- The MariaDB driver is loaded in `executeStatement` at `web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:1211-1212`, and the `DATABASE_MARIADB` constant is defined at `:107`.
- `isCurrentDatabase` (`web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:1188-1190`) is a substring match on the connection URL, so `jdbc:mariadb://...` matches `"mariadb"` and not `"mysql"`.
- The tests that pin this behaviour are `web/src/test/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilterE2ETest.java:839-843` (MariaDB URL) and `:845-850` (MySQL URL). I did not find a test that exercises the create-user path itself with a MariaDB URL.

**Repository names:** I used `github.com/openmrs/openmrs-core` for searches, since bare `openmrs-core` was rejected. Citations below use the bare name.

**Other tools:** `api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/util/DatabaseUtil.java:88` and `api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/util/DatabaseUpdater.java:486` also treat `jdbc:mariadb` as MySQL. They are related but are not the wizard's user-creation path, so I left them out of the ranking.

**Evidence, best first**

- openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:1501-1505 (create user SQL, MySQL and MariaDB branch)
- openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:1518-1521 (GRANT, MySQL and MariaDB branch)
- openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:1492-1496 (drop user, MySQL and MariaDB branch)
- openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:1211-1212 (MariaDB driver load)
- openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:1188-1190 (isCurrentDatabase)
- openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:107 (DATABASE_MARIADB constant)
- openmrs-core/web/src/test/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilterE2ETest.java:839-843 (MariaDB URL test)
- openmrs-core/web/src/test/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilterE2ETest.java:845-850 (MySQL URL test)
